description: Traffic Count Vehicle Classification 2014-2017 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. The City of Melbourne employs a contractor to perform traffic counts on roads throughout the municipality. The numbers of vehicles are recorded per hour and split into 12 categories based on the Austroads vehicle classification. Vehicle class 13 is used when the type of vehicle can’t be determined. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are count, movement, transport, vehicle. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, KML, PDF, XLS. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
